# أَتَبَصْبَصَ (ʔatabaṣbaṣa) /ʔa.ta.basˤ.ba.sˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَبَصْبَصَ (tabaṣbaṣa)
# أَتَبَصْبَصْ (ʔatabaṣbaṣ) /ʔa.ta.basˤ.basˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَبَصْبَصَ (tabaṣbaṣa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
